gold_note: Early dinosauriform cladogram. Each coloured box spans exactly one clade; its vertical name is kept as an internal label (Lagerpetidae, 'Dinosaurifor.' as printed, Dinosauria, Saurischia, Theropoda, Sauropodomorpha). Several fans are entered at a child's height (Silesaurus, Scutellosaurus, between Petrified forest theropod and Zupaysaurus, Chromogisaurus), read as one node, as in earlier batches. 44 tips, 5 polytomies (4, 3, 4, 5, 3 children); 6 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Random-sample case (seed 20261114). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
